newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Huge NBS, RMB deal goes through SAfrica JSE.
newsitem.headline: Huge NBS, RMB deal goes through SAfrica JSE.

text.p: The sale of RMB Holdings' 22.2 percent stake in NBS Holdings, a deal announced in March, moved through the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on Tuesday, driving NBS shares to a new high, dealers said.
"The talk of the day has been the NBS transaction," one trader said.
The deal of 18 million shares worth 1.357 billion rand moved through the market at 1328 GMT, nearly half an hour before the close of the trading session.
NBS shares gained a rand to a new high of 83 rand in a volume valued at nearly 86 million rand.

South Africa's Board of Executors Ltd (BOE) announced on March 13 that it had would buy 22.2 percent of NBS from RMB for 1.37 billion rand or 68.35 cents a share. At the same time, the newly merged NBS Boland Bank group said it would buy 24.3 percent of BOE for 880 million rand.
BOE would team up with the merged NBS and Boland Bank Holdings Ltd to create South Africa's fifth largst banking group.

RMB shares on Tuesday rose 70 cents to 11.50 rand in a volume of over 4.6 million shares valued at 52 million rand. But dealers said the price and volume movement were unrelated to the NBS transaction.
BOE shares were steady at 130 rand in thin volume valued at just under a million rand.
